title: Replace Paperclip with the in-repository task tracker
body: ADR 0015 records the shipped Git-backed `tasks/<id>.json` tracker, its `krn task` commands, and the no-import decision. Product Paperclip was removed in #109; GLOBAL forwarding is shipped in #457 and #459, and claim mutations use the kernel-held per-task lock in #110.

This delivery records the current tracker and routing, adds repository rules, and seeds follow-up work in `tasks/`. GLOBAL Paperclip removal remains a separate backlog item at `t-yxxfg7k`. Paperclip and legacy queue data are not imported.
